description: Analyze 8 unidentified binary files in /home/ga/Evidence/seized_files/ to determine which are VeraCrypt encrypted volumes. A list of candidate passwords is provided at /home/ga/Evidence/candidate_passwords.txt. Attempt to mount each file using the candidate passwords. If a file mounts, identify its Encryption Algorithm and Hash Algorithm (available via 'Volume Properties'). Dismount volumes after analysis. Create a forensic report at /home/ga/Evidence/forensic_report.txt listing all 8 files. Format each line as: 'VOLUME: <filename> | Encryption: <algorithm> | Hash: <hash_algorithm> | Password: <password>' for volumes, and 'NOT_VOLUME: <filename>' for non-volumes.
